fact: The Digital Convergence Initiative says Cameroon is assessing its Common ID System, Civil Registration System and Disability Registry to explore their integration with the Unified Social Registry (RESUC) MIS.
system: Unified Social Registry (RESUC) Management Information System

fact: The World Bank appraisal document says the Unified Social Registry information system, to be built under MINAS with project funds, will consolidate the existing databases of the Social Safety Nets Project, the Cash for Education Program, the Caisse Nationale de Prevoyance Sociale and the World Food Programme, with a pilot registry running since 2015 in 15 communes and 64,424 individuals.
